name: solutions.avineon/mcp
title: Avineon: FME tools and training
description: FME transformers and docs search, licences, Flow Hosted costs, training, Esri: AI-ready data

tools.name: get_company_overview
tools.description: Overview of Avineon, a geospatial company in the UK, the Netherlands, Belgium and France: what it does, its services, FME and Esri ArcGIS offerings, training, industries, accreditations and contact details. Use this first for general questions about the company.

locale.description: Website language: en-gb (English, UK), nl-nl (Dutch), be-nl (Flemish, Belgium) or fr-fr (French). Default en-gb.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List Avineon's services (data management, integration solutions, managed services, professional services), technology offerings (FME, ArcGIS products and licensing) and industries, as a tree with short descriptions and page keys. Use get_page with a page key for full details.

locale.description: Website language: en-gb (English, UK), nl-nl (Dutch), be-nl (Flemish, Belgium) or fr-fr (French). Default en-gb.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Full text of one Avineon web page: a service, technology product, industry, case study, training course, blog post or other page. Pass a page_key from another tool (for example 'services/geospatial-managed-services') or a full URL. Returns the page's details as JSON, then its full text as plain text. Also lists the page's other language versions.

page.description: Page key, path or full URL.

url.description: A page's full URL; the same as page.

locale.description: Website language: en-gb (English, UK), nl-nl (Dutch), be-nl (Flemish, Belgium) or fr-fr (French). Default en-gb.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search all of Avineon's web pages (services, technology, industries, case studies, training, blog, events, about) with a keyword or natural-language query. Returns ranked pages with snippets. Falls back to English when the chosen language has no match.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. 'utility network migration' or 'FME training in Dutch'.

locale.description: Website language: en-gb (English, UK), nl-nl (Dutch), be-nl (Flemish, Belgium) or fr-fr (French). Default en-gb.

tools.name: search_case_studies
tools.description: Find Avineon case studies (customer projects) by keyword, industry or technology, e.g. 'utility network', 'water', 'FME Flow Hosted', 'rail'. Without a query, lists all case studies.

locale.description: Website language: en-gb (English, UK), nl-nl (Dutch), be-nl (Flemish, Belgium) or fr-fr (French). Default en-gb.

tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.description: Contact details for Avineon by topic and country: email address, relevant pages and forms, phone numbers and office addresses. Topics: general, fme_licensing (FME Form and FME Flow quotes), fme_training (courses and dates), flow_hosted (FME Flow Hosted), services (projects), support (existing customers). The locale picks the country: en-gb UK, fr-fr France, nl-nl Netherlands, be-nl Belgium.

locale.description: Website language: en-gb (English, UK), nl-nl (Dutch), be-nl (Flemish, Belgium) or fr-fr (French). Default en-gb.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List Avineon's events from the website as separate events with dates: conferences, the FME UK Tour, Geo Explore and other sessions, upcoming first, plus the current FME Skill Booster workshop topic and the recorded-sessions page. Past events are left out unless include_past is true.

locale.description: Website language: en-gb (English, UK), nl-nl (Dutch), be-nl (Flemish, Belgium) or fr-fr (French). Default en-gb.

include_past.description: Also return events whose date has passed.

tools.name: search_fme_transformers
tools.description: Search the FME transformer library (Safe Software built-in transformers and selected FME Hub transformers) by name, keyword or capability, e.g. 'reproject', 'join attributes', 'point cloud'. Returns name, category, description, how widely it is used in real workspaces, and the documentation link.

tools.name: get_transformer_details
tools.description: Details of one FME transformer: description, category, documentation link, how often it is used, which transformers are most often connected before and after it, and example workspaces (with links to Safe Software's articles) that use it.

tools.name: list_transformer_categories
tools.description: List the FME transformer categories with the number of transformers and the most-used transformers in each.

tools.name: find_transformers_for_task
tools.description: Suggest FME transformers for a task described in plain language, e.g. 'find features within 100 m of a road and write a report' or 'read a CSV, geocode addresses and load to a database'. Based on transformer chains in real example workspaces; returns suggested transformers, typical chains and example workspaces.

tools.name: search_fme_docs
tools.description: Find Safe Software's FME documentation and resources for a question: documentation pages (transformers, readers and writers, FME Form, FME Flow, FME Flow Hosted), support articles, FME Community posts, webinars, FME Hub items and example workspaces. Returns titles, links and short excerpts only; open the link for the full page.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. 'PostGIS writer bulk insert' or 'FME Flow automation schedule'.

kind.description: Only one kind: documentation, support (articles), forum (FME Community), webinar, hub (FME Hub) or example (workspaces).

tools.name: find_fme_training
tools.description: List Avineon's FME training courses (FME Form introductory, best practice and advanced; FME Flow authoring; FME with APIs and AI; ArcGIS Data Interoperability; FME Skill Booster workshops) with level, price, duration, upcoming dates (from the booking forms) and the course page link. Filter by level, product or topic; the locale picks the language and currency.

locale.description: Website language: en-gb (English, UK), nl-nl (Dutch), be-nl (Flemish, Belgium) or fr-fr (French). Default en-gb.

tools.name: get_arcgis_online_backup_manager
tools.description: Facts about Backup Manager for ArcGIS Online, a SaaS backup and restore service for hosted feature services, web maps and applications: what it backs up and what it doesn't (ArcGIS Hub, Notebooks, ArcGIS Enterprise), scheduling and retention, security and data residency, pricing, how to start a trial, how it compares with other ArcGIS Online backup options, and links. For a cost estimate use estimate_arcgis_online_backup_cost.

locale.description: Website language: en-gb (English, UK), nl-nl (Dutch), be-nl (Flemish, Belgium) or fr-fr (French). Default en-gb.

tools.name: estimate_arcgis_online_backup_cost
tools.description: Estimate the yearly cost of backing up ArcGIS Online content with Backup Manager (GBP, excluding VAT), using the same model as the calculator on the website. Describe one or more backup sets: number of hosted feature layers, records per layer, kind of content, attachments and their average size, daily or weekly, and copies kept; or give the size of one copy in GB if known. Returns storage per set, total storage, the pricing tier, annual cost and the history each set gives. With no sets, it uses the website's example.

backup_sets.description: Backup sets, e.g. operational data daily and reference data weekly.

layers.description: Hosted feature layers in this set.

records_per_layer.description: Typical records (features or rows) per layer.

content.description: Mostly points, survey points, simple polygons, lines, complex polygons or dense linework (default points).

attachments.description: Photos or documents attached across the set.

attachment_mb.description: Average attachment size in MB (default 3; typical 0.5, 3, 8 or 20).

content_gb.description: Size of one copy of the set in GB, if known; replaces layers, records and attachments.

frequency.description: How often the set is backed up (default daily).

locale.description: Website language: en-gb (English, UK), nl-nl (Dutch), be-nl (Flemish, Belgium) or fr-fr (French). Default en-gb.

tools.name: recommend_fme_licence
tools.description: Suggest which FME products fit a described use (FME Form, FME Flow or FME Flow Hosted; fixed or floating licences; or the ArcGIS Data Interoperability extension), with the reasoning, the assumptions made, and links to licensing pages and contacts.

scenario.description: How FME will be used, e.g. 'two analysts convert CAD to GIS weekly and want it to run every night without IT servers'.

authors.description: People who will build or edit workspaces.

automate.description: Workspaces should run on a schedule, on triggers or as web services.

self_host.description: The organisation can run its own servers or cloud machines.

arcgis_pro.description: The authors work in Esri ArcGIS Pro.

locale.description: Website language: en-gb (English, UK), nl-nl (Dutch), be-nl (Flemish, Belgium) or fr-fr (French). Default en-gb.

tools.name: get_fme_licensing_overview
tools.description: Overview of FME licensing and subscriptions (FME Form, FME Flow and FME Flow Hosted) from Avineon's licensing pages, with contact details. FME Form and FME Flow prices are quote-based; for FME Flow Hosted estimates use estimate_fme_flow_hosted_cost.

locale.description: Website language: en-gb (English, UK), nl-nl (Dutch), be-nl (Flemish, Belgium) or fr-fr (French). Default en-gb.

tools.name: estimate_fme_flow_hosted_cost
tools.description: Estimate FME Flow Hosted costs from Safe Software's published pricing (USD): annual plan versus pay-as-you-go, including instance hours, disk storage, backups and data transfer. Give an instance size (standard, professional, select, premium, enterprise) or the number of parallel jobs to size it. Also returns the break-even point and contact details.

instance_size.description: standard (2 cores, 8 GB), professional (4, 16 GB), select (8, 32 GB), premium (16, 64 GB) or enterprise (48, 192 GB).

parallel_jobs.description: Jobs to run at the same time; used to choose a size when instance_size is not given.

hours_per_month.description: Hours the instance runs each month; 730 = always on (default).

disk_gb.description: Total disk in GB (minimum 40; by default 40, or enough to hold data_gb).

data_gb.description: Data stored on the FME Flow data disk in GB; backups are charged on this (default 5).

outbound_gb_per_month.description: Data sent to the internet per month in GB (default 10).

in_region_gb_per_month.description: Data transferred within the same AWS region per month in GB (default 0).

engines.description: FME engines you plan to run (engines are unlimited; about one per core is recommended).

locale.description: Website language: en-gb (English, UK), nl-nl (Dutch), be-nl (Flemish, Belgium) or fr-fr (French). Default en-gb.
